contents: An upcoming tournament (starts 2026-08-12). 6 stages, 112 undecided team slots. Trimmed to 1 stage and 3 matches, all of them TBD.

verification.verbatim: elements are verbatim; truncated from 6 stages to 1 and from 10 matches to 3
verification.tbdConvention: confirmed — teamA and teamB are plain null, with teamAScore/teamBScore 0 and maps []. No sentinel object, no "TBD" string, inverting Riot's convention.

pairedWith: esports-world-cup-2026-cs2_matches.json, captured in the same minute, which is empty.

recapture.reason: CS2 via BLAST is off the roadmap (SPEC §0, §8: "a second source is last"). scripts/capture-fixture.ts only knows the Riot REST envelope; BLAST is a different API entirely (api.blast.tv/v2) with no shared client.
